CHAP USTUN:
7) 'The Simpsons have bought a house and have decorated the living-room. Look at the picture and use the prompts to write sentences in the passive, as in the example.' SURAT: bezatilgan mehmonxona (yog'och shift, zinapoya, gilam, divanlar, javon). 1 A: Did they paint the walls? B: walls/paint/a week ago → Yes. The walls were painted a week ago. 2 A: Have they ordered curtains yet? B: No. Curtains/not order/yet 3 A: Will they build a fireplace? B: Yes. A fireplace/build/next week 4 A: Did they buy a new sofa? B: Yes. A new sofa/buy/last month 5 A: Have they hung any pictures on the walls? B: Yes. Pictures/hung/on the walls/already 6 A: Did they put up the shelves? B: Yes. Shelves/put up/yesterday 7 A: Have they laid the carpets yet? B: No. The carpets/not laid/yet 8 A: Did they hang the chandelier? B: No. The chandelier/hang/on Tuesday

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct passive tense of the verbs in brackets.' SURAT: Nyu-York (Egizak minoralar). One of the most famous bridges in North America is the George Washington Bridge. It 1) ...... (name) after the first American president and the states of New York and New Jersey 2) ...... (connect) by it. The bridge 3) ...... (design) by Othmar H. Amman, a Swiss-born engineer and it 4) ...... (complete) in 1931. It 5) ...... (make) so that cars could travel more quickly and easily to and from the two states. In 1962, a lower deck with more traffic lanes and a modern bus terminal 6) ...... (add). On the New York side, one of the towers of the bridge 7) ...... (build) on land whereas on the New Jersey side, the other tower 8) ...... (place) in the Hudson River. It is worth crossing the bridge because the incredible New York skyline 9) ...... (can/see) from there.
9) 'Read the newspaper article and fill in the gaps with the verbs in brackets using the passive.' 'Earthquake Hits Whiterose': Whiterose's city centre 1) ...... (seriously/damage) yesterday morning when it 2) ...... (hit) by an earthquake measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale. Fifty people 3) ...... (injure) and more than two hundred 4) ...... (trap) under debris since 10 am. It 5) ...... (believe) by experts that another earthquake may strike the area again in the near future. The local council announced this afternoon that money 6) ...... (give) to help those in need. Any donations to charitable organisations 7) ...... (collect) by Mrs Randall on Monday from 9:00 - 5:00.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '47'.

exercises.instructionUz: Simpsonlar uy sotib olib, mehmonxonani bezatishdi. Suratga qarang va ko'rsatmalar bilan majhul nisbatda gaplar yozing, namunadagidek. 1 A: Devorlarni bo'yashdimi? B: walls/paint/a week ago → Ha. Devorlar bir hafta oldin bo'yalgan. 2 A: Parda buyurtma qilishdimi? B: No. Curtains/not order/yet 3 A: Kamin qurishadimi? B: Yes. A fireplace/build/next week 4 A: Yangi divan sotib olishdimi? B: Yes. A new sofa/buy/last month 5 A: Devorga rasm osishdimi? B: Yes. Pictures/hung/on the walls/already 6 A: Javonlarni o'rnatishdimi? B: Yes. Shelves/put up/yesterday 7 A: Gilam to'shashdimi? B: No. The carpets/not laid/yet 8 A: Qandilni osishdimi? B: No. The chandelier/hang/on Tuesday
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL ZAMONI → JAVOB ZAMONI
  (majhul).

  1 Did → were painted a week ago
    (NAMUNA)
  2 Have ... yet → haven't been
    ordered yet
  3 Will → will be built next week
  4 Did → was bought last month
  5 Have → have already been hung
  6 Did → were put up yesterday
  7 Have ... yet → haven't been
    laid yet
  8 Did ... No → will be hung on
    Tuesday (kelajak - hali
    osilmagan)


⚠ 'A FIREPLACE':

  = kamin.


⚠ 'A CHANDELIER':

  = qandil.


⚠ 'TO LAY CARPETS':

  = gilam to'shamoq (lay - laid).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct passive tense of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri majhul zamoni bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JORJ VAShINGTON KO'PRIGI (Nyu-
  York - Nyu-Jersi).

  1 is named after (hozir ham -
    fakt)
  2 are connected (hozir)
  3 was designed (o'tgan)
  4 was completed in 1931
  5 was made (o'tgan)
  6 was added (In 1962)
  7 was built (o'tgan)
  8 was placed (o'tgan)
  9 can be seen (modal)


⚠ 'TO BE NAMED AFTER':

  = ... nomi bilan atalmoq.


⚠ 'A LOWER DECK':

  = pastki qavat (ko'prik).


⚠ 'THE SKYLINE':

  = shahar silueti (osmono'par
  binolar).


⚠ 'IT IS WORTH + -ING':

  = ... ga arziydi.

items.textEn: One of the most famous bridges in North America is the George Washington Bridge. It ___ (name) after the first American president
items.whyUz: ⚠ Nomi hozir ham shunday → is named.

items.textEn: and the states of New York and New Jersey ___ (connect) by it.
The bridge ___ (design) by Othmar H. Amman, a Swiss-born engineer
It ___ (make) so that cars could travel more quickly and easily to and from the two states.
In 1962, a lower deck with more traffic lanes and a modern bus terminal ___ (add).
On the New York side, one of the towers of the bridge ___ (build) on land
whereas on the New Jersey side, the other tower ___ (place) in the Hudson River.
It is worth crossing the bridge because the incredible New York skyline ___ (can/see) from there.

ZILZILA HAQIDA MAQOLA.

  1 was seriously damaged
    (yesterday morning)
  2 was hit (o'tgan)
  3 were injured (people - ko'plik)
  4 have been trapped (since 10
    am - hozirgacha)

    kelajak)

  kuchi).

patterns.formula: Have they + V3 + yet? — No. NIMA + hasn't / haven't been + V3 + yet.
patterns.exampleEn: Have they ordered curtains yet? — No. Curtains haven't been ordered yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Parda buyurtma qilishdimi? — Yo'q. Pardalar hali buyurtma qilinmagan.

patterns.formula: NIMA + is named after + KIM / was designed by + KIM / was completed in + YIL
patterns.exampleEn: It is named after the first American president. It was completed in 1931.
patterns.exampleUz: U birinchi Amerika prezidenti nomi bilan atalgan. U 1931-yilda bitkazilgan.

patterns.formula: It is believed (by experts) that + GAP
patterns.exampleEn: It is believed by experts that another earthquake may strike the area.
patterns.exampleUz: Mutaxassislar tomonidan yana bir zilzila bo'lishi mumkin deb hisoblanadi.
